objective: Collect the first project-declared, network-disabled native collection or wheel-build evidence on the unchanged Dev-5 environment plans.

runner_contract.source: Create a local no-hardlinks detached checkout from the retained Git object database at the exact inherited revision; never fetch or read dirty worktree files.
runner_contract.cleanliness_gate: Require exact HEAD and tree identity plus an empty git status before adding declared external fixtures or running bootstrap.
runner_contract.container_git_gate: Add only /data/project to Git safe.directory for the temporary bind mount.
runner_contract.mount: Mount the temporary checkout at /data/project and EnvSolve policy code read-only.
runner_contract.external_fixture: Create only preregistered safe single-component directories after the clean-checkout gate and fail on repository-path collision.
runner_contract.bootstrap: Source the exact inherited frozen bootstrap in one persistent shell without creating benchmark result artifacts.
runner_contract.network_transition: Allow network only during bootstrap; disconnect every Docker network before V4 planning and execution.
runner_contract.v4_planning: Prefer content-addressed explicit pytest configuration; otherwise use standard pyproject.toml or setup.py build metadata; never use repository identity or execute arbitrary project commands.
runner_contract.v4_execution: Use fixed direct argv without a shell, PIP_NO_INDEX=1, no bytecode, no pip version check, a 300-second probe timeout, bounded diagnostic tails, and temporary wheel output.
runner_contract.v4_decision: Pytest exit zero passes, exit five is unknown, other nonzero or timeout fails; wheel build requires exit zero and at least one content-addressed wheel; no plan or outcome is unknown.
runner_contract.temporary_storage: Use the host platform temporary directory unless an explicit bind-mount-safe root is supplied.
runner_contract.cleanup: Always remove the container and temporary checkout.

expected_causal_checks.planner: Every observed probe kind and configuration hash must match frozen_planner_expectations before its outcome is interpreted.
expected_causal_checks.collection: Collection success claims only import-time test discovery, not test execution or V5.
expected_causal_checks.build: Build success requires a wheel artifact hash and does not imply native tests exist.
expected_causal_checks.network: Every planned probe executes only after Docker has no connected network and the container has no default route.
expected_causal_checks.bootstrap: A bootstrap failure leaves V4 unknown and is classified separately from the native probe.
expected_causal_checks.official_outcomes: No official verifier runs and no official score changes.
